meta.description: Simplified multi-state economic nexus calculator. Thresholds and state rates researched from each state's official revenue department website. This is NOT tax advice: it ignores product taxability, exemptions, local rates, marketplace-facilitator collection, and physical-presence nexus.

states.name: California
states.rate_note: 7.25% statewide base (includes 1.25% local); district taxes may add
states.click_through: Marketplace sales count toward the seller's $500k threshold; facilitators collect on facilitated sales

states.name: New York
states.lookback: immediately preceding four sales tax quarters
states.rate_note: 4% state rate; local taxes add on top; 0.375% MCTD surcharge inside the MCTD
states.click_through: Marketplace sales count toward threshold; provider collects on facilitated sales

states.name: Texas
states.lookback: preceding 12 calendar months (total Texas revenue, incl. non-taxable)
states.rate_note: 6.25% state rate; local tax adds up to 2%
states.click_through: No separate click-through threshold; marketplace sales count toward safe harbor

states.name: Washington
states.rate_note: 6.5% state retail sales tax; local rates add on top
states.click_through: Click-through and 200-transaction thresholds eliminated 2019-03-14; marketplace sales count toward receipts threshold

states.name: Florida
states.rate_note: 6% state rate plus county discretionary surtax (not modelled)
states.click_through: UNVERIFIED from a readable DOR page — verify before relying on this row
states.unverified_note: Florida DOR pages did not expose readable text during research; number is from DOR search results and must be confirmed at floridarevenue.com

states.name: Illinois
states.rate_note: 6.25% general merchandise; 1% for qualifying drugs/medical; local rates may apply
states.click_through: Marketplace facilitators have a related $100k threshold; no click-through modification stated

states.name: Massachusetts

states.unverified_note: Mass.gov pages could not be fetched during research; $100k is the commonly cited threshold but must be confirmed

states.name: Colorado
states.rate_note: 2.9% state rate ONLY — home-rule local jurisdictions set their own; combined rates are much higher and not modelled

states.name: Georgia
states.rate_note: 4% state rate; local option taxes add up to 4%
states.click_through: DOR directs marketplace questions to marketplace-facilitator guidance; no click-through modification verified
states.unverified_note: Rate verified from dor.georgia.gov; $100k threshold comes from DOR bulletin SUT-2019-02 which could not be text-extracted — confirm before relying on this row

states.name: North Carolina
states.rate_note: 4.75% general state rate; local and transit taxes may increase the total
states.click_through: Marketplace-facilitated sales count toward threshold; engaged facilitator collects and remits
